name: scope-anti-expansion-gate
title: Add scope anti-expansion gate before INIT_CHECK
description: Add a lightweight INIT to INIT_CHECK gate that freezes user-confirmed scope before any worktree is created. Canonical boundary source is scope-boundary.json written from story_create inputs or an explicit INIT-only scope_boundary_set repair; absent boundary blocks INIT_CHECK. The gate blocks excluded future-capability keywords for correctness_fix stories by default, routes reviewer expansion through explicit proposals, and treats discard digest repeats as blockers unless a mitigation is recorded.
